						About Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) Recruitment 2025 Mains Mains Result 2026: Out Now!

						Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced the recruitment of 500 Office Assistant (Peon) posts for 2025, offering a prestigious opportunity to join one of India’s leading public sector banks. The online application process is open from May 3 to May 23, 2025, through the official website https://www.bankofbaroda.in. Eligible candidates must have passed the 10th standard, be proficient in the local language of the state/union territory they apply for, and meet the age criteria (18–26 years as of May 1, 2025). This recruitment drive is ideal for candidates seeking stable banking jobs with opportunities for growth.
						

						
						

						Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) 2025 – Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

						The online application starts on May 3, 2025, and ends on May 23, 2025.

						🌐 Q2. Where can I apply for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						Apply online at the official website: https://www.bankofbaroda.in or trusted portals like https://www.resultbharat.com.

						🎓 Q3. What is the eligibility for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						Candidates must have passed the 10th standard, be proficient in the local language of the state/union territory, and be aged 18–26 years as of May 1, 2025.

						💸 Q4. What is the application fee for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						General/OBC/EWS: Rs. 600/-; SC/ST/PH/All Female: Rs. 100/-. Pay via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

						📄 Q5. What documents are required for the BOB Office Assistant application?
						You need a scanned passport-size photo, signature, 10th standard certificate, and other documents as specified in the notification.

						📋 Q6. What is the selection process for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						The selection process typically includes a written test and/or interview, followed by document verification, as per the official notification.

						📝 Q7. How can I apply for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						Visit https://www.bankofbaroda.in, register, fill the application form, upload documents, pay the fee, and submit by May 23, 2025.

						About Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) Recruitment 2025 Mains Mains Result 2026: Out Now!

						Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced the recruitment of 500 Office Assistant (Peon) posts for 2025, offering a prestigious opportunity to join one of India’s leading public sector banks. The online application process is open from May 3 to May 23, 2025, through the official website https://www.bankofbaroda.in. Eligible candidates must have passed the 10th standard, be proficient in the local language of the state/union territory they apply for, and meet the age criteria (18–26 years as of May 1, 2025). This recruitment drive is ideal for candidates seeking stable banking jobs with opportunities for growth.
						

						
						

						Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) 2025 – Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

						📅 Q1. When does the application for Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) 2025 start?
						The online application starts on May 3, 2025, and ends on May 23, 2025.

						🌐 Q2. Where can I apply for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						Apply online at the official website: https://www.bankofbaroda.in or trusted portals like https://www.resultbharat.com.

						🎓 Q3. What is the eligibility for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						Candidates must have passed the 10th standard, be proficient in the local language of the state/union territory, and be aged 18–26 years as of May 1, 2025.

						💸 Q4. What is the application fee for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						General/OBC/EWS: Rs. 600/-; SC/ST/PH/All Female: Rs. 100/-. Pay via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

						📄 Q5. What documents are required for the BOB Office Assistant application?
						You need a scanned passport-size photo, signature, 10th standard certificate, and other documents as specified in the notification.

						📋 Q6. What is the selection process for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
						The selection process typically includes a written test and/or interview, followed by document verification, as per the official notification.

						📝 Q7. How can I apply for BOB Office Assistant (Peon) 2025?
